facts.text: First-year students living on campus at UVA Wise reside with a roommate in traditional double-occupancy rooms before choosing suite or apartment styles later.

sources.title: Campus Facilities - UVA Wise
sources.quote: During your first year, you will live with a roommate in a traditional double-occupancy room, and then in your upper-class years, you can choose from a range of suite- and apartment-style housing options
